headline: Integration test: informer syncs and follows changes through router
summary: Adds a subtest that runs a dynamic informer against the plugin API through the router. It checks that the cache syncs, that a created object produces an add event, and that an update produces an update event. It only adds coverage for watch streaming, so a short summary is enough and a line-by-line review can be skipped.
